name: Mochizuki Amane
source: A tall, gorgeous, and very stylish girl. When quiet, she is beautiful and seems kind, but can be somewhat of an airhead. She is the sole member of Keifuu Academy’s Soaring Club. She continues to enroll in school even after many years in order to complete the self-built glider for her best friend. Although she's a genius, she can be quite clumsy when things are not going so well.
